title: No Badge, No Board
description: The nav hides the "Fleet & scheduling" link from customers and drivers — but a hidden link isn't the same as a locked door. Check whether typing the URL directly still lets the wrong badge onto the dispatch floor.
successCondition: Logged in as a customer or driver account, directly navigating the browser to /fleet is checked against what actually renders — document precisely whether the FleetBoard page content (or an error/redirect) appears, since FleetPage itself contains no client-side role check beyond requiring some accessToken to be present. Whatever the actual behavior is, record it exactly (renders full board / renders but data calls fail with visible errors / redirects) rather than assuming the nav's hiding of the link is sufficient protection.
hints: Compare this to /admin, which also has no route-level role guard beyond ProtectedRoute — the real enforcement for both pages happens at the API layer (403 responses), not in the route itself.

If the page renders but every data-fetching call 403s, note what the resulting UI actually looks like — an unhandled or confusing error state is itself worth flagging even if data access is correctly blocked.
